description: In front on the bed surface are a yellow plate with a red tomato slice on it, a green plate to the right, two dice, a small white cube, and a couple of toy blocks and a bread slice near the back. The left hand reaches in toward the yellow plate, grips the tomato slice as a left-hand object, lifts it up and carries it rightward over the dice, then lowers it onto the green plate and releases it, while the right hand stays nearby without touching anything.
